# Offline mode dropped

Coding rule · `S3.9`

Offline mode is dropped. No new offline caching/queuing of routes or data. Network loss is handled as an error state (no logout, retry), not as offline availability. The half-removed cache read stays until a task targets it (S0.2).

Part of [[Features/App launch, permissions, crash, offline|App launch, permissions, crash, offline]].
